versions.content: When development error detection is enabled for the Wdg module: The function Wdg_SetMode shall set the Wdg module’s state to WDG_BUSY during its execution (indicating, that the module is b usy) and shall reset the Wdg module’s state to WDG_IDLE as last operation before it returns to the caller.
